cues.zh: 很难想象会用“老派”来形容一种生物，
cues.en: It ought to be impossible to describe a creature as looking old fashioned,
but that's exactly how Sirocco looks.

cues.zh: 大大的鬓角，维多利亚绅士般的面孔。
cues.en: With his big side burns and his victorian gentleman's face.

cues.zh: 看他在森林灌木丛里溜达，还真挺有意思。
cues.en: It's actually nice to see him wandering around in the forest undergrowth.

cues.zh: 你看他的伪装非常出色。
cues.en: You can see he's got very good camouflage.
He has, that colour is incredible.

cues.zh: 看来进化并没有完全把他淘汰掉。
cues.en: So evolution hasn't entirely rendered him useless.
Hello.
Are you gonna look in the lens?

cues.zh: 典型的雄性，Sirocco显然只对一件事感兴趣。
cues.en: A typical male, Sirocco is clearly only interested in one thing.
Oh, hello!
Oh, look a that!
Ow!
God he's got sharp claws.
He's getting a bit frisky.
Ow!

cues.zh: 你觉得他是不是在——他真的在尝试某种求偶仪式吗？
cues.en: Do you think it is a- he's actually attempting a sort of mating ritual?
He is?
You are being shagged!
Ow, wow it's sharp.
Look, he's so happy!

cues.zh: 抱歉，但这真是我见过最好笑的事情之一。
cues.en: I'm sorry but it's one of the funniest things I've ever seen.

cues.zh: 你正被一只稀有鹦鹉交配。
cues.en: You are being shagged by a rare parrot.
He thinks you are a female.
Ow!
He's really going for it.
Wow, you've chosen him.
Actually, you are in pain aren't you.
It's alright.
Oh, his neck-.
He's fine but it's really sharp claws.
Did that hurt?
Yeah, it did hurt.

cues.zh: 是啊，这儿有血，这儿有血，这儿也有血。
cues.en: Yeah, you've got blood there and blood there and blood there.

cues.zh: 说实话我们得给你包扎一下，因为情况不太妙。
cues.en: We should patch you up to be honest 'cause it's not good.
Well!

cues.zh: 我想让你叫那只雏鸟——等你有了雏鸟，我想让你替我给它起名叫Stephen。
cues.en: I want you to call the chick- when you have the chick, I want you to call it Stephen for me.
Would you do that?

cues.zh: 我不太确定该怎么理解这话。
cues.en: I'm not sure how to take that.

cues.zh: 你嘴里会生出一颗小蛋。
cues.en: A little egg will come out of your mouth.

cues.zh: 女士们先生们，你们见证了电视史上的第一次。
cues.en: Ladies and gentlemen you've seen a television first.

cues.zh: 你们看到Mark Carwardine，他一生致力于保护动物，竟真的亲身
cues.en: You've seen Mark Carwardine who has devoted his life to conserving animals, actually taking

cues.zh: 积极参与到全新一代、全新物种的保护与繁育之中。
cues.en: an active part in the conservation and breeding of a whole new generation of a whole new species.
Homo-Kakapens.

cues.zh: 它要生一只小鸮鹦鹉了。
cues.en: He's going to give birth to a little kakapo.
We're very proud of you.
Do you want to have a go?
I think I'll pass actually.
